Select distinct chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles for molecules linked to document CHEMBL1139796. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, then to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by docs.chembl_id = CHEMBL1139796 and require canonical_smiles to be present. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
